reviewed_by: Codex; independent fresh-context TUI root-cause validation before repair
reason: The paired terminal client now shows Core-owned working, waiting, idle, and unknown states for visible conversations and in the F3 picker. Focused tests cover rail ordering and truncation, ETag polling, failure and project-switch isolation, Core activity semantics, a paired TLS LAN Core journey with another client starting and stopping a turn and an approval wait, plus current product guidance discovery and Chroma source-digest synchronization. The disposable Core now uses a fixture-owned idle host-load sampler so its turn-admission evidence is deterministic under real Mac CPU pressure. The Settings assistant catalog regression checks the new destination aliases and guidance. A focused rail test proves an older selected main chat remains visible even outside the recent catalog page.
exclusions: No browser page, native runtime, or Core activity route changed. The UI catalog edit adds search keywords only; its focused frontend test covers discoverability. Browser Playwright profiles and native tests are not applicable to the Python terminal display. The paired LAN test uses synthetic projects and inert provider/harness fixtures, not live Core data.
